comments.author: RebarBotNava
comments.body: PHASE 1 — Incident RCA (debugging protocol): 2nd memory-exhaustion incident. Root cause proven: git fsmonitor--daemon x ~120 worktrees (one daemon each, unbounded watch memory), compounded by 3 concurrent fully-parallel xdist test suites (goldeneye bug) and unbounded background helpers reaching PPID 1. Terminal RSS + slow post-reboot login explained (login-time daemon respawn storm). Disproof checks run against logs before accepting. Remediation landed: fsmonitor disabled, orphaned-process detector (scripts/check_orphaned_load.py) + docs/orphaned-processes.md + AGENTS.md bounding rules, worktree sweeps, memory-aware PYTEST_WORKERS autoscaling (change 2886), goldeneye closed. Keychain/cache clearing by operator judged non-causal.

comments.body: PHASE 2 — Overnight autonomous orchestration (operator handoff): 6 long-lived agents managed via warm re-tasking. Board drained ~175 tickets (184-orphan inventory -> low single digits). Highlights: review-bot + Gerrit replication restored after secret rotation (stale-credential class fixed 3x: HTTP password, deploy key, webhook tokens — restart-on-rotation + auth-verifying health checks, changes 2819/2832/2841); administrative --class closes for all ticket types (2831); replacement-ticket crediting in close precheck (2853); refs/changes replicated to GitHub mirror making CI Gerrit-independent (2902); marmot O(events) probe batching (2863); Gerrit repair protocol hardened after pussycat recurrence + noolbenger main-moved-backward repair (backup refs, never write refs/heads from mirror).

Design rulings recorded on tickets: sheep/ADR 0118 snapshot_alpha default-off + gated enablement chain, dalmatian combined corroborator hardening (2901), sunfish manifest cap-script derivation (2910), roadrunner Option A.

Flake policy enforced: hawk xdist worker-crash RCA'd to a 3s pytest-timeout marker under coverage, fixed 2932 (not retried). Worktree salvage per ruling: 69+3 removed after Change-Id-based landed-ness refinement (Gerrit rebase-on-submit means SHA-reachability lies), calib4 worktree proven to BE the missing code-v5 calibration artifact -> 2861 merged + gander thresholds 2934 merged. membound WIP file-by-file assessment delegated. comment-remediation-* and rebar-close-* worktree families protected (other sessions').

comments.body: PHASE 5 — MCP client scoping (ticket irregular-basic-bubblefish): codex startup failure RCA'd — valid PAT but GUI-launched processes never source ~/.zshenv, so bearer env var absent -> server 401 -> codex renders 'not logged in'. Fixes: launchctl setenv publishing in refresh-mcp-pats.sh (all PAT vars); operator ruled claude+copilot consolidate onto MCP_CLIENT_PAT_CLI (claude slot), codex keeps its own; project scoping via tracked .mcp.json (claude project scope + copilot >=1.0.83 workspace config, precedence verified empirically) and .codex/config.toml [mcp_servers.rebar]; global entries removed after merge. Verified: copilot loads .mcp.json first-found over .github/mcp.json; workspace overrides user config.

Open handoffs for next session: visionary-geologic-harrier (windows sweep red 3 scheduled runs, POSIX-only import suspected), kakarikis pip-audit CVEs (in flight at freeze), muntjac telemetry gap, xerus soak due 2026-09-13, porpoise measurement outcome per blackfly-ops report, ~/rebar-membound verdict, ADR 0118 chain state (sponge/redstart/hammerkop). Environment at close: 0 AWS alarms, orphan check clean, 38% mem free, swap ~9.7/10.2GB (stale — recommend orchestrator process restarts), 292 worktrees (mostly other sessions' comment-remediation + plan-review-comparison; protected). Main gating cell green via Gerrit; scheduled-run reds = pip-audit + windows sweep only.
